summary: GM Financial Automobile Leasing Trust 2026-3 filed a 424B5 prospectus under Rule 424(b)(5) for a $954,930,000 asset-backed notes offering backed by auto leases. The issuing entity issued six classes of notes plus a subordinated retained class. Terms include Class A-1 at 4.002%, Class A-2-A at 4.33%, and Class B at 4.71%, with Class A-2-B floating at SOFR plus 0.35%. Underwriting discounts total $2,130,920 and proceeds to seller are $952,729,063. Joint bookrunners include BMO, Credit Agricole, Goldman Sachs, and RBC. This is a routine structured finance issuance, not a special situation. Watch for note performance and credit enhancement mechanics.
